title: item-copy job
description: Defines which Sitecore items item-copy transfers between environments.

source.description: Source environment name, as configured in .env (SITECORE_<NAME>_HOST etc.).

destination.description: Destination environment name, as configured in .env.

database.description: Sitecore database on both sides. Defaults to master.

items.description: Items to transfer, applied to the destination in this order.

scope.description: SingleItem transfers only this item; ItemAndDescendants transfers the whole subtree.

mergeStrategy.description: How to handle items that already exist in the destination. OverrideExistingTree deletes the destination item and all its descendants before writing.
